author: Mark Atwood
text: [2026-05-11 scope refinement] Foundation work (JmapBackend trait reshape + read-side handle_* in jmap-server) split into sibling bead JMAP-g7wu.1.9 for cleaner per-crate scope tracking, matching the pattern established by closed JMAP-g7wu.1.4 (which earlier split off the ClosureHandler foundation work). The 'jmap-server | JmapBackend associated-type + method signatures + handle_get/changes/query/query_changes' row of the design-lock comment's implementation-scope table is now tracked in .1.9 rather than here. This bead (.1.1) is now scope-limited to the MailBackend canonical reshape only. All beads still land atomically in one mega-PR per the 5c decision; the split is organizational, not a delivery-boundary change.
